A.
History and Development of the Company
We
were incorporated on April 23, 2009 in Australia under the name Gumiyo Australia Pty Ltd. On January 14, 2021, we changed our name to
Locafy Limited. Our principal executive offices are located at 246 Churchill Avenue, Subiaco, Western Australia 6008, Australia and our
telephone number is +61 409 999 339. On March 25, 2022, we completed our initial public offering in the United States. Our ordinary shares
and warrants are listed on Nasdaq under the symbols “LCFY” and “LCFYW”, respectively. Our website address is
www.locafy.com . The information contained on, or that can be accessed through, our website is not a part of this Annual Report.
We have included our website address in this Annual Report solely as an inactive textual reference.
The
SEC maintains an internet site at www.sec.gov that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding
issuers that file electronically with the SEC. As a foreign private issuer, we are exempt from the rules under the Exchange Act that
prescribe the furnishing and content of proxy statements to shareholders.
Recent
Acquisitions
On
February 18, 2026, we acquired the customer base of Growth Pro Agency, a digital marketing firm founded by Jason Jackson, who joined
Locafy as our Chief Operating Officer. The purchase price was up to US$138,996 and contingent upon customer revenue retention for 12
months following the acquisition. As at June 30, 2026 we estimate that the total final consideration will be approximately US$31,452.
On
May 5, 2026, we acquired Sales AIgent, an agentic AI technology, from Jason Jackson, our Chief Operating Officer, and John File. The
purchase price of US$97,500 (A$136,059) was settled via the issue of 21,708 ordinary shares, comprising 10,854 ordinary shares issued
to each of Mr. Jackson and Mr. File.
During
the year ended June 30, 2026, we also acquired map boosting technologies from Aitomation for US$318,750 (A$460,724). The purchase
consideration is subject to dispute. While the dispute is ongoing and the ultimate outcome cannot presently be determined, we have
recognized a liability relating to the balance of the unpaid purchase consideration under the acquisition agreement. See Note 15 and
Note 16 to our consolidated financial statements.
On
October 1, 2026, we entered into a business sale and purchase deed (the “Map Labs Purchase Agreement”) with Map Labs,
LLC and Map Labs Licensing, LLC to acquire the Map Labs business, a U.S.-based maps marketing software and services business, and
its assets. The assets include its technology platform, software, intellectual property, customer contracts and customer
prepayments. The purchase price is up to US$3.0 million in cash. Of that, US$2.0 million is payable at settlement. Up to US$1.0
million more is contingent on the acquired business reaching specified revenue targets for calendar years 2027 and 2028, payable in
up to US$500,000 for each year. As of the date of this Annual Report, no financing arrangements have been finalized or committed to fund the upfront consideration.
Accordingly, there can be no assurance that we will be able to obtain the funding required to complete the acquisition on acceptable
terms or at all. The transaction is scheduled to close on or before December 31, 2026 or such other date as the parties agree, and
is subject to conditions, including approval by our board of directors and no material adverse change in the Map Labs business
having occurred. As of the date of this Annual Report, settlement has not occurred, and we cannot assure you that the acquisition
will be completed on the expected terms or timetable, or at all. If our board of directors determines not to approve the transaction
and we give the sellers written notice that we will not proceed as a result, we will be required to reimburse the sellers for their
reasonable and properly incurred out-of-pocket costs and expenses directly related to the transaction, up to a maximum aggregate
amount of US$100,000. A copy of the Map Labs Purchase Agreement is filed as Exhibit 4.9 to this Annual Report. See “Item 5.
Operating and Financial Review and Prospects—B. Liquidity and Capital Resources” and Note 34 to our consolidated
financial statements for more information.

Capital Expenditures
Our
capitalized development costs were A$1,323,066, A$1,624,211 and A$1,629,897 for the years ended June 30, 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

B.
Business Overview
Overview
We
are an Australian company currently focused on commercializing our AI-powered Software as a Service (“SaaS”) online marketing
platform (“Platform”), which comprises our various proprietary Technology applications (“Technology”). Our Platform
primarily delivers a cost-effective location-based digital marketing solution for small businesses in our key target markets of the USA,
Australia and Canada. Our Platform’s core objective is to improve visibility in traditional online search and AI search results
at a lower cost and in a faster timeframe than alternative solutions. Key elements of the Platform include:
●
Websites
built leveraging AI that also incorporate our Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) technical know-how;
●
Business
Listing Management and the syndication of business details to generate wider online search prominence;
●
Map
Pack Booster technology that increases visibility in Google’s Map Pack (also referred to as the “Local Pack”) search
results;
●
AI-assisted
Google Ads Management technology; and
●
Article
creation and distribution through Press Release channels.
At
the core of our Website products are the SEO and AEO structures and know-how that we have developed over many years. We have more recently
leveraged AI and automation to be able to develop websites at a fraction of the time and cost compared to traditional means. We also
incorporate features, including: page speed, accessibility, security and unique quality content that we believe contribute towards improving
Search Engine Results Page (SERP) rankings and more recently having these websites featured as “sources” cited in AI Search
results. Websites can be managed through our Platform’s content management system.
Our
Business Listing syndication solution enables a business owner to publish their business details to multiple directories, search engines,
voice assistants, maps, apps and social media platforms, relevant to the market they operate. While this increases audience reach for
that business, we also believe that accurate business details published consistently in many publishing “endpoints” has a
positive effect on SEO and AEO outcomes. Through AI and automation, our Platform can also re-purpose content from business listings and
append additional content from other sources, including the business’ existing website to produce a Website that incorporates our
technology. By employing AI and automation we are able to scale Website production.
Our
Map Pack Booster solution uses our proprietary technology and know-how to increase the search ranking of a user’s Google Business
Profile (GBP) within Google’s Map Pack for relevant keywords within a radius of up to 20 miles of the business’ physical
location. Where customers operate a service area business, we can target a specific region and have the potential to target a wider area
than is typically possible with a fixed-location business.
The
Company recently developed a technology solution within our Platform that enables clients to manage their Google Ads campaigns. Our solution
leverages AI to create advertising strategies to optimize advertising spend return on investment (ROI).
Locafy
customers can create Articles in the Platform using our AI-powered article generator. The article can then be published on the client
website and syndicated to other online publications via press releases.
We
also own customer databases, including Hotfrog, a global online business directory, and four additional Australian-focused directories,
AussieWeb.com.au (“AussieWeb”), PinkPages.com.au (“PinkPages”), SuperPages.com.au (“SuperPages”)
and Scoop.com.au (“Scoop”). As of June 2026, combined, these directory assets contain more than 65 million business listings.
We
monetize these solutions through a combination of service, subscription and advertising fees which are charged on both a fixed and variable
(e.g. volume-based pricing)
